items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Rico Stone' appears only in a parenthetical note linking a song title to the artist, with no direct interaction or personal connection described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: I remember a place -- I don't know what the name of it was but it was based on 'Tiger Rag' that Frankie Trumbauer played and it was a real great solo.
And all the saxaphone players dug it. You know. It went like this -- (singing). You remember that one?
